verses.text: 548. The signs worked by Jesus attest that the Father has sent him. They invite belief in him. (cf. Jn 5:36; 10:25, 38.) To those who turn to him in faith, he grants what they ask. (Cf. Mk 5:25-34; 10:52; etc.) So miracles strengthen faith in the One who does his Father’s works; they bear witness that he is the Son of God. (Cf. Jn 10:31-38.) But his miracles can also be occasions for “offence”; (Mt 11:6.) they are not intended to satisfy people’s curiosity or desire for magic Despite his evident miracles some people reject Jesus; he is even accused of acting by the power of demons. (Cf. Jn 11:47-48; Mk 3:22.)
